title: Correlation clustering · queries and optimal-cluster oracles
description: Ordinary graph access and an oracle for the optimal partition are distinct resources. Each facet keeps its output and accuracy contract visible.
coverage: Bounded review of the five supplied primary sources, checked 26 October 2026. Eight supplied records preserved and one lower bound added from the same source set; not a claim of exhaustive literature coverage.
